disabled.title: Evaluation is off
disabled.description: Observability is disabled for this deployment, so experiments cannot run.

empty.title: No experiments yet
empty.description: Pick a frozen dataset version and a Bot configuration to submit the first experiment.

forbidden.title: You cannot run this experiment
forbidden.description: Experiments follow the Bot's management rights and are re-checked before every sample.

basic.title: Score unavailable for this sample
basic.description: The sample produced no score. A missing score is not a zero, and it is excluded from the average rather than counted as a failure.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: This field could not be handled safely, so only metrics are shown. Omitted is not the same as empty.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: This value exceeds the recorded size limit and was cut.

syncing.title: Results still syncing
syncing.description: The experiment finished but its scores are not confirmed upstream yet. Syncing is not success.

unavailable.title: Upstream unavailable
unavailable.description: The observability store did not answer. Runs already in flight kept their hold; nothing was released or double-charged.
